actions.message: Contribute less, or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident3 contributed over 10 units in the last round; using my wallet I apply the maximum affordable punishment (severity 23) and broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning:
We have wallet 7.1, free rider threshold 10, so wallet below threshold, cannot rest? Rest is allowed regardless but rule: if wallet above threshold rest. Here wallet 7.1 <10, so cannot rest, must act. Check recent round contributions: round3 contributions: Resident3 contributed 28 (>10). So we must punish that resident with maximum severity affordable. Severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost) = floor(7.1/0.3)= floor(23.666)=23. So we can punish Resident3 with amount 23. That costs 23*0.3=6.9, leaving wallet 0.2. That's okay.

Also after punishing we can also broadcast warning. Allowed up to one physical and one communication. So do punish and broadcast.

Return actions.

Explanation brief.
